question: Can you calculate the median from the highest season goals of each team?
sql:
-- Verify using percentile_cont
WITH team_season_goals AS (
    SELECT home_team AS team, season, SUM(home_team_goal) AS total_goals
    FROM match_view
    WHERE home_team IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY home_team, season
    
    UNION ALL
    
    SELECT away_team AS team, season, SUM(away_team_goal) AS total_goals
    FROM match_view
    WHERE away_team IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY away_team, season
),
team_season_totals AS (
    SELECT team, season, SUM(total_goals) AS season_total
    FROM team_season_goals
    GROUP BY team, season
),
team_max_goals AS (
    SELECT team, MAX(season_total) AS max_goals
    FROM team_season_totals
    GROUP BY team
)
SELECT PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY max_goals) AS median_max_goals
FROM team_max_goals

{"sql": "-- Calculate the median of the highest season goals for each team
WITH team_season_goals AS (
    SELECT home_team AS team, season, SUM(home_team_goal) AS total_goals
    FROM match_view
    WHERE home_team IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY home_team, season
    
    UNION ALL
    
    SELECT away_team AS team, season, SUM(away_team_goal) AS total_goals
    FROM match_view
    WHERE away_team IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY away_team, season
),
team_season_totals AS (
    SELECT team, season, SUM(total_goals) AS season_total
    FROM team_season_goals
    GROUP BY team, season
),
team_max_goals AS (
    SELECT team, MAX(season_total) AS max_goals
    FROM team_season_totals
    GROUP BY team
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT max_goals,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY max_goals) AS rn,
           COUNT(*) OVER () AS total_count
    FROM team_max_goals
)
SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN total_count % 2 = 1 THEN 
            (SELECT max_goals FROM ranked WHERE rn = (total_count + 1) / 2)
        ELSE 
            (SELECT AVG(max_goals) FROM ranked WHERE rn IN (total_count / 2, total_count / 2 + 1))
    END AS median_max_goals
FROM ranked
LIMIT 1", "preview_rows": 1}
